notes: Parts are unchanged from step 1: no breadboard, the SCP1000 breakout is wired directly to the Arduino Uno with 7 hook-up wires (5 blue signal, 1 red 3.3 V, 1 black GND).

Pin mapping follows the schematic and sketch: SCK-D13, MISO-D12, MOSI-D11, CSB-D7, DRDY-D6. In the schematic the DRDY and CSB lines cross, so D7 goes to CSB and D6 goes to DRDY. (The step 1 note describing this was worded confusingly.)
The sensor is powered from the Uno 3.3V pin (red wire), not 5V, because the SCP1000 is a 3.3 V part. GND goes to the Uno's GND pin next to the power header, taken as GND.1.
The SCP1000 breakout's logic pins are connected directly to the Uno's 5V I/O as the tutorial shows, without level shifters. The tutorial does not add any.
